# Configuration

<!-- Generated by `python -m mebot.config --markdown`; do not edit by hand. -->

All settings are environment variables (or lines in `.env`). In the Docker image
`DATA_DIR=/data`, `FRONTEND_DIST=/app/static` and `LEGAL_DIR=/app/legal` are preset.

| Variable | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `MODE` | `single` | single = one bot, no tenancy. hosted = many owners, each with their own bot. |
| `SECRET_KEY` | *(unset)* | Encrypts stored API keys and keys the IP hashes. Required when MODE=hosted; in single mode one is generated once into <DATA_DIR>/secret.key. Changing it means re-entering API keys. |
| `DATA_DIR` | `backend/data` | Directory for the SQLite db and the generated secret key. |
| `DATABASE_URL` | *(unset)* | Defaults to sqlite:///<data_dir>/mebot.db when unset. |
| `TELEMETRY` | `on` | "off" = no heartbeat, registration or update check: zero network calls to the registry. |
| `REGISTRY_URL` | `https://registry.shivanshmishra.in` | Where heartbeats / registrations go. Read once at startup. |
| `TELEMETRY_WORKERS` | `true` | Background telemetry jobs (heartbeat, registration, update check). Tests turn them off. |
| `OLLAMA_HOST` | `http://127.0.0.1:11434` | Only the suggested base URL for the "ollama" provider; the model and provider are chosen in setup / Admin -> AI Provider. |
| `CORS_ORIGINS` | `http://localhost:5173` | Comma-separated allowed browser origins (also used by the admin CSRF origin check). |
| `SETUP_TOKEN` | *(unset)* | If set, POST /api/setup must include a matching setup_token. Recommended when the first boot is reachable from the internet. |
| `COOKIE_SECURE` | `false` | Force the Secure flag on auth cookies (set when TLS terminates at a reverse proxy). |
| `TRUST_PROXY` | `false` | Trust X-Forwarded-Proto / X-Forwarded-For from a reverse proxy. |
| `TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY` | *(unset)* | Optional Cloudflare Turnstile on new chats (also needs the toggle in Admin -> Limits). |
| `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` | *(unset)* | Server-side Turnstile secret, paired with TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY. |
| `PUBLIC_URL` | *(unset)* | Public base URL (https://bot.example.com). Enables the Telegram webhook option and "Open chat" links in notifications. |
| `TELEGRAM_WORKERS` | `true` | Background Telegram tasks (poller, outbox, digest). Tests turn them off. |
| `FRONTEND_DIST` | `frontend/dist` | Built frontend (npm run build). When it holds an index.html the backend serves the whole UI (app, embed bundle, widget loader) with per-path cache headers. |
| `GITHUB_TOKEN` | *(unset)* | Optional token for GitHub imports (public data only; raises the 60/hour limit). A token saved in Admin -> Import takes precedence. |
| `RETRIEVAL_THRESHOLD_TOKENS` | `6000` | Profiles above this many (estimated) tokens are not sent whole: only the parts relevant to each question are. Per-bot override in Admin -> Knowledge (auto / always / off). |
| `RETRIEVAL_BUDGET_TOKENS` | `2500` | Token budget for the retrieved profile excerpts in one prompt. |
| `ALLOW_SQLITE_HOSTED` | `false` | Hosted mode needs Postgres (DATABASE_URL=postgresql+psycopg://...). Set to 1 to run hosted on SQLite anyway: development only, one process, a warning on every start. |
| `HOSTED_DOMAIN` | *(unset)* | Optional wildcard domain: {slug}.HOSTED_DOMAIN serves that bot's recruiter page. Without it, bots live at /b/{slug}. |
| `SIGNUP_MODE` | `invite` | Who may sign up: open (anyone), invite (needs an invite code), closed (nobody). |
| `SMTP_HOST` | *(unset)* | Outgoing mail (verification, password reset). Without SMTP_HOST mails are printed to the log instead (development only). |
| `SMTP_PORT` | `587` | SMTP port; 587 uses STARTTLS, 465 implicit TLS. |
| `SMTP_USER` | *(unset)* | SMTP login (optional). |
| `SMTP_PASSWORD` | *(unset)* | SMTP password (optional). |
| `SMTP_FROM` | `mebot <no-reply@localhost>` | From address on platform mail. |
| `PLATFORM_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` | *(unset)* | Maintainer pings (sign-ups, suspensions) via your own Telegram bot. Best-effort. |
| `PLATFORM_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID` | *(unset)* | Chat that receives the maintainer pings (your user id or a group id). |
| `HOSTED_MAX_DAILY_MESSAGES` | `500` | Hard caps per tenant: owners can lower their limits, never raise them above these. |
| `HOSTED_MAX_DAILY_TOKENS` | `1000000` | Daily token budget cap per tenant (a tenant can't switch it off). |
| `HOSTED_MAX_SESSION_MESSAGES` | `40` | Messages per visitor chat. |
| `HOSTED_MAX_IP_PER_DAY` | `100` | Messages per visitor IP per day. |
| `HOSTED_MAX_IMPORTS_PER_DAY` | `10` | Import uploads per tenant per day (one import runs at a time per tenant). |
| `HOSTED_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES` | `5000000` | Largest import upload per tenant, in bytes. |
| `BILLING_PROVIDERS` | *(unset)* | Comma-separated billing providers: razorpay (INR), stripe (USD and others). |
| `RAZORPAY_KEY_ID` | *(unset)* | Razorpay API key id (rzp_test_... in test mode). |
| `RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET` | *(unset)* | Razorpay API key secret. |
| `RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | *(unset)* | Razorpay webhook secret (Dashboard -> Webhooks), checks X-Razorpay-Signature. |
| `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` | *(unset)* | Stripe secret key (sk_test_... in test mode). |
| `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | *(unset)* | Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_...), checks Stripe-Signature. |
| `BILLING_GRACE_DAYS` | `7` | Days a bot keeps serving after a failed payment before it goes offline. |
| `TRIAL_DAYS` | `14` | Free trial length in days (ends earlier if TRIAL_MESSAGES run out). |
| `TRIAL_MESSAGES` | `200` | Free trial message allowance. |
| `TERMS_VERSION` | `2026-10` | Version of the terms owners accept at sign-up; bump when docs/legal changes. |
| `PLATFORM_GSTIN` | *(unset)* | Platform GSTIN shown on the billing page (optional). |
| `LEGAL_DIR` | `docs/legal` | Folder with terms.md / privacy.md / refunds.md, served at /legal/{name} in hosted mode. The bundled files are templates: replace them after legal review. |
